task: Stop local-server tests timing out under full-suite load
measured: Under pnpm -r test (workspaceConcurrency: 2), socket tests hit the 5000ms vitest default at 5013–5016ms wall time before failing (packages/deepgram/src/tts.test.ts, packages/server-websocket/src/index.test.ts). Budget: 15000ms (3× the observed ~5s load ceiling).
approach: Shared vitest.socket.config.ts at repo root (SOCKET_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000) extended by vitest.config.ts in each of the 7 socket packages; server-websocket merges fileParallelism: false. Removed the real TCP server from deepgram 'realigns PCM split across binary frame boundaries' — byte-stream realignment is exercised via injectable FakeSocket (same handleAudio path, no bind/handshake).
sabotage: Temporarily dropped carry-byte join in DeepgramTTSPlugin.handleAudio (buf = frame instead of concatBytes(carry, frame)). Test failed: AssertionError: expected Buffer[ 17, 34 ] to deeply equal Buffer[ 17, 34, 51, 68 ] — the trailing 0x33/0x44 from the second binary frame were lost. Restored carry logic.
